title: Legendary Chikibamboni
description: The return of the legend! Transforms ordinary Minecraft sheep into the iconic, compact Chikibamboni.
body:
The Return of Chikibamboni!
This resource pack completely replaces the vanilla sheep model and wool in Minecraft with the iconic, compact, and perfectly square Chikibamboni. Turn your sheep farms into a legendary meme! This pack fully supports all wool colors.

⚠️ Requirements (Important):
To make the custom model work in your game, you must use the following mods:

EMF (Entity Model Features)

ETF (Entity Texture Features)
![mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f49ec6f51f6c09066853ab5cd609d239b16a2394.png)
![mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a9fe8d33f8dcc4a61abf23919d9c04871f41937.png)

**instal ETF** [https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)


**instal EMF** [https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)
